title: COATVFMIL Clientside
description: Collection Of All The Vanilla Friendly Mods I Like. works on vanilla servers.
body:
Collection Of All The Vanilla Friendly Mods I Like, or COATVFMIL, was created over the course of a month as I struggled to enjoy minecraft without server side mods. (a friend of mine had made a vanilla server and made no modifications to it).

There were a few things that I didn't include, those being:

[VanillaTweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/) resource pack (I would reccomend speccing it out to your liking)

[Physics Mod Pro](https://www.patreon.com/Haubna) (Computationally expensive. if you have a powerful computer, I would highly reccomend it!)

[Complementary Unbound](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound/version/latest) Shaders (Same deal as Physics Mod Pro)

Forks of [Xali's Enchanted Books](https://github.com/Estecka/mc-Xalis-Enchanted-Books/releases/tag/pre4) and [Xali's Potions](https://github.com/Estecka/mc-Xalis-Potions/releases/tag/pre3) (I would have used the origionals, however [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) (a mod these resource packs depend on) has not been updated for 1.21.3 as of current. instead i am using an alternative, [Variants-CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit), that required modified versions of these texture packs which i cant put in this modpack for liscening reasons.)
